title: Shared client portal before payment and tenant boundaries are decided
task: Turn the client's portal idea into a buildable next step. Keep useful independent work moving, make consequential uncertainty explicit, and avoid silently selecting a business model or publishing target.

sources.text: The approved first release is a client portal for a small design agency. Clients upload assets and comment on deliverables. It must work locally on Windows. Customer files stay private until a reviewed sharing policy is approved. No paid purchase, external deployment, or real customer-data upload is authorized. Preserve keyboard and screen-reader access.

I'd like clients to collaborate, maybe see each other's projects, and pay in the app. Get the shell moving while we figure that out. I have not decided whether this is one agency or separate tenant workspaces, who can see another client's files, subscription versus invoice payment, or where it will go live.
Current source commit-a has a local React shell with placeholder navigation. There is no authentication, sharing, payment integration, test receipt, or release receipt.

constraints.text: Keep customer assets private pending a reviewed sharing policy.
No purchase, external deployment or real-data upload has been authorized.

actions.text: Build local accessible navigation using synthetic placeholders.
Enable clients to read each other's projects.
Connect live billing and begin charging clients.

evidenceItems.text: Whether this portal is built, verified and ready to release.
